user.title: Xfinity
user.description: Home Assistant signs in through your Browserless account. The password is stored in this integration and sent to Browserless only when signing in.

data_description.address: The street address where Xfinity service is installed. It is used for outage checks.
data_description.username: Your Xfinity ID, usually the email address or username used to sign in at xfinity.com.
data_description.password: The password for that Xfinity ID. It is stored in Home Assistant and sent to Browserless only when signing in.
data_description.browserless_api_key: The API key from your Browserless account. Residential proxy units are used for each sign-in.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Xfinity again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved sign-in was rejected, or Xfinity asked for a verification code. Enter the password and Browserless API key.

data_description.password: The current password for the saved Xfinity ID.
data_description.browserless_api_key: The API key from your Browserless account, used to run the sign-in browser.

reconfigure.title: Xfinity settings
reconfigure.description: Update the service address or Browserless API key. The password is unchanged.

data_description.address: The street address where Xfinity service is installed. It is used for outage checks.
data_description.browserless_api_key: The replacement API key from your Browserless account.

error.invalid_auth: Xfinity rejected that username or password.
error.invalid_client: Xfinity rejected this integration's app credential. Update the integration.
error.invalid_address: Enter a street address between 5 and 200 characters.
error.mfa_required: Xfinity asked for a verification code. Approve it in the Xfinity app, then try again.
error.browserless_error: Browserless could not run the sign-in. Check the API key and remaining units.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Xfinity or Browserless.

invalid_auth.message: Xfinity rejected the saved sign-in. Update the password or Browserless API key.

invalid_client.title: Xfinity needs an integration update
invalid_client.description: Xfinity rejected this integration's application credential. Update the Xfinity integration. Pasting a new refresh token will not fix this.
